Subject: Re: Eval collaboration — assets and next steps

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the latency and the rollout controls. We'd like to move forward with a short MAP and an asset exchange so we can run a 2‑week evaluation against a representative set of prompts and testcases.

High level from our side:
- We'll provide a ~5k prompt/testcase bundle (mix of anonymous customer logs + synthetic prompts) and a small promptpack.
- Usage constraints: data must remain ephemeral in sandbox, no long‑term retention beyond 30 days, and no re‑distribution.
- Acceptance: automated eval pass rate >= 85% on our seed suite, human spot checks for hallucination.
- Timeline: hope to start staging week of Mar 24 and finish by Apr 7.

I attached a one‑page doc listing our requirements — can you confirm if Redwood can host the assets under those constraints and if you have a MAP template we can sign? Also need an indicative timeline for onramp and who from your side will be the technical owner.

Best,
Liam

Attachment: Edgeway_requirements_v1.pdf (PDF, 1 page)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-03-15T11:03:00-07:00

Hi Liam — great to hear. We're happy to run this pilot. Quick answers up front, then a proposed MAP and next steps attached.

Can do ephemeral sandboxing with automatic takedown after 30 days; we'll enable prefix/KV caching control and disable long‑term logging of prompt content (we will still capture telemetry for debugging unless you request otherwise). We can accept the sample size and your acceptance criterion as a starting point.

I've attached:
- Redwood_MAP_Edgeway_v1.pdf — draft Mutual Action Plan with milestones and responsibilities
- promptpack-sample.zip — small example of how we'll ingest promptpacks (schema README included)

Key asks from our side:
1) Signed MAP or approval via DocuSign (I included a draft in the MAP pdf).
2) Clarify whether we should redact any fields in the sample logs prior to upload (PII question).
3) A single technical point‑of‑contact for staging and a procurement contact for contract movement.

Proposed high‑level milestones (from MAP):
- Mar 24: Asset ingest into staging (Edgeway uploads S3 presigned links)
- Mar 25–26: Integration smoke tests + baseline eval
- Mar 27–Apr 4: Evaluation window (automated + human spot checks)
- Apr 7: Closecall and acceptance review

If that timeline works, I'll initiate the DocuSign for the MAP and loop in Karthis (legal clearance) and Ben (ops) for final gating.

Thanks — Marissa

Forwarding Edgeway's requirements + my draft MAP. Quick points for review before I send DocuSign:

Karthik — can legal confirm the "ephemeral 30‑day" retention clause as written in the MAP (section 3) is sufficient or if we need a stronger auditable deletion statement? Also check the redaction ask (PII).

Ben — ops: can the staging pool be pinned for the two‑week window with KV prefix cache disabled for the seed suite? Also flag any quantization/throughput notes if the promptpack requires long sequence lengths.

Monica — are there any billing/discount constraints we should offer (they're an early customer but evaluating multiple vendors)? I want to avoid pre‑committing credits before legal and ops sign off.

I'll wait for quick thumbs (EOD PDT) — I don't want to stall their Mar 24 start date.
